title: Employee Relations Manager
cardSummary: A mobile and web platform that gives employees one place to access company information, manage schedules, and stay connected.
sub: A mobile and web platform that gives employees one place to access company information, manage schedules, and stay connected.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.headline: One place for everything employees need
paragraphs: A mobile and web platform that gives employees one place to access company information, manage schedules and stay connected.

sections.heading: The challenge
sections.headline: Many stakeholders, no early access to users
paragraphs: A large number of stakeholders with different priorities made alignment slow, and there was no direct access to end users early on, which limited how well assumptions could be validated. The product still needed several business-critical modules.

sections.heading: Process
sections.headline: Fewer decision-makers, faster iteration
paragraphs: Low-fidelity prototypes went to stakeholders for feedback first. Narrowing the number of decision-makers over time sped up iteration and sharpened the discussion. Once the core workflows were validated, I moved into visual design and reusable components.
User testing was not available up front, but the first release generated real employee feedback that shaped later refinements and pushed the team toward a more user-centred process.

sections.heading: 01 — Work schedules
sections.headline: Hours at a glance, control for managers
paragraphs: Employees get instant access to their hours and daily status. Managers get more: visibility into subordinates’ schedules and the ability to edit shifts, hours and attendance directly in the system.

sections.heading: 02 — Chatbot
sections.headline: A deliberately simple flow
paragraphs: An internal chatbot simplifies access to company information.

sections.heading: 03 — Salary calculator and reports
sections.headline: Earnings and bonuses, made understandable
paragraphs: A dedicated module helps employees understand their earnings and bonus calculations: entering relevant data, calculating expected payments, reviewing bonuses and tracking changes over time.

result: The platform unified essential employee services into one ecosystem — better access to information, more transparency, and simpler everyday interactions between employees and the company.
